description: 14 positive webhook parity cases (workflow-test.MD Section J, 2026-09-10 cycle).

cases.name: simple_webhook
cases.notes: Plain webhook trigger with no downstream processing.

cases.name: simple_webhook_2 (Set node)
cases.notes: Webhook -> Set. Response body must wrap the payload under `body`.

cases.name: bocahtuanakal (Set calculation)
cases.notes: Webhook -> Set with an expression; basic-auth header required by the workflow.

cases.name: webhook_callrest (HTTP Request + basic auth)
cases.notes: Webhook -> HTTP Request with basic-auth credentials; the credential envelope must resolve.

cases.name: webhook_xml (XML <-> JSON)
cases.body: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><buku id="001"><judul>Belajar Pemrograman Web</judul><penulis>John Doe</penulis><tahun>2026</tahun><harga mataUang="IDR">120000</harga></buku>
cases.notes: XML round-trip. n8n collapses attributes into child elements; both trees are equivalent.

cases.name: webhook_loop (loop node)
cases.notes: Webhook -> Code -> Loop Over Items -> respond all.

cases.name: token_auth (JWT bearer)
cases.environment_blocked: The fixture token is a fixed JWT from an earlier cycle: both hosts reject it with 403 because it is expired or signed with the old secret. A freshly minted token for the shared instance is required, and the harness cannot mint one because the instance's JWT secret is not exposed.

cases.name: auth_apikey (header auth)
cases.environment_blocked: The header-auth API key of the shared instance is not in the repository, so the fixture key is rejected with 403 by both hosts. The key configured on the instance is required to exercise this path.

cases.name: user-signup (end-to-end signup)
cases.environment_blocked: The signup workflow calls an external signup service that is not reachable from this network; both hosts answer 500 in the same way. The upstream service has to be available for the happy path.
cases.notes: Full signup flow: webhook -> code -> http -> respond.

cases.name: process-batch-orders
cases.notes: Batch order pipeline: code -> if -> loop -> switch -> set -> code -> summary.

cases.name: db_quiry (MySQL branch)
cases.notes: Webhook -> if (db_type) -> MySQL branch. Regression guard for GAP-2026-09-10-1.

cases.name: db_quiry (PostgreSQL branch)
cases.notes: Webhook -> if (db_type) -> PostgreSQL branch. Regression guard for GAP-2026-09-10-2.
